 Shopee Live's GMV increased 12 times, saving users 16 trillion VND.
 Shopee's "11-11 Sale of the Year" concluded with many positive growth indicators across its live shopping channels. According to statistics released by Shopee, on the peak day of November 11th alone, the total transaction value (GMV) of the Shopee Live channel recorded a 12-fold increase compared to a normal day.
 Báo Sài Gòn Giải phóng • 20/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Shopee's "11-11 Sale of the Year" event offers many practical benefits for consumers. Along with the increase in sales, the number of orders generated through livestream sessions on the platform on November 11th also recorded a nine-fold increase compared to a normal day.
 Throughout the entire campaign, the two interactive shopping channels, Shopee Live and Shopee Video, attracted a total of nearly 2.5 billion views from consumers. Besides entertainment and product information, the synchronized promotional programs implemented by Shopee, brands, and sellers helped Vietnamese consumers save a total of up to 16 trillion VND during the event.
 Ahead of the 11-11 shopping festival, Shopee is simultaneously implementing various communication activities and entertainment programs to increase the campaign's reach to users. A highlight is the collaboration between Shopee and the boy band UPRIZE, who will serve as brand ambassadors for the year-end shopping season.
 You may also like The TV commercial “Abracadabra Shopee 11-11 - The Biggest Sale of the Year,” using the melody of the song “Abracadabra” combined with outdoor advertising and accompanying content, has garnered over 26 million views and interactions across Shopee’s official media channels. 
 The "11-11 Biggest Sale of the Year" event delivered many outstanding results. Alongside media activities, the online music festival "Top Live Stars," held on the night of November 10-11, attracted over 7 million views on Shopee Live and other live streaming platforms. The program offered 360-degree performances by numerous artists, along with direct shopping deals during the livestream. Simultaneously, the interactive "One Click to Win a Flight Ticket" program integrated into the Shopee app also attracted nearly 30 million users.
 In conjunction with the platform, the community of sellers and brands on Shopee actively prepared their inventory and increased live interaction sessions on November 11th. Statistics show that the number of new products listed on Shopee on the peak day of November 11th increased sevenfold compared to a normal day. In addition, the number of livestream sessions independently conducted by sellers and brands on Shopee on November 11th also increased threefold compared to a normal day.
 You may also like For products of Vietnamese origin, consumers continue to prioritize many essential product categories for daily life. The product categories that recorded the highest sales volume during the 11-11 sale included: Clothing ( fashion category), facial skincare products, beverages, snacks, and household cleaning products.
 Based on the results achieved in the 11-11 event, Shopee plans to continue investing in its technology platform, enhancing the interactive shopping experience, and developing solutions to support sellers in order to serve the peak shopping season at the end of the year and the Lunar New Year 2027.
